run_ml_train_co2r: run ML model training on CO2R experimental data with random forest and cross validation
run_ml_train_her: run ML model training on HER experimental data with linear regression and leave-one-out cross validation
run_ml_train_with_processed_df: run ML training using a preprocessed CSV dataframe instead of raw experimental and computational files
run_ml_train_with_el_features: run ML training with Matminer elemental features added to the adsorption energy descriptors
run_ml_train_filter_matched: run ML training filtered to only XRD matched samples with a specified energy aggregation method
